-- The question asks for:
-- 1. Calendar year
-- 2. Total sales for the four weeks leading up to June 15
-- 3. Total sales for the four weeks following June 15
-- 4. Percentage change in sales

SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    pre_sales,
    post_sales,
    ROUND(1.0 * (post_sales - pre_sales) / pre_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM (
    WITH weekly_totals AS (
        SELECT 
            calendar_year,
            week_date,
            CAST(week_date AS DATE) AS wd,
            CAST(calendar_year || '-06-15' AS DATE) AS june_15,
            SUM(sales) AS total_sales
        FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
        WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
        GROUP BY calendar_year, week_date
    ),
    pre_weeks AS (
        SELECT 
            calendar_year,
            total_sales,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY wd DESC) AS rn
        FROM weekly_totals
        WHERE wd < june_15
    ),
    post_weeks AS (
        SELECT 
            calendar_year,
            total_sales,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY wd ASC) AS rn
        FROM weekly_totals
        WHERE wd > june_15
    ),
    pre_totals AS (
        SELECT calendar_year, SUM(total_sales) AS pre_sales
        FROM pre_weeks
        WHERE rn <= 4
        GROUP BY calendar_year
    ),
    post_totals AS (
        SELECT calendar_year, SUM(total_sales) AS post_sales
        FROM post_weeks
        WHERE rn <= 4
        GROUP BY calendar_year
    )
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_year,
        p.pre_sales,
        po.post_sales,
        ROUND(1.0 * (po.post_sales - p.pre_sales) / p.pre_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change
    FROM pre_totals p
    JOIN post_totals po ON p.calendar_year = po.calendar_year
    ORDER BY p.calendar_year
)
